enrichment.headline: Extends the Escape Technology contract one year without bidding, up to $1,277,826.55
enrichment.summary: The board finds the district can extend its Escape Technology contract for one more year, July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023, without competitive bidding. It also approves Addendum No. 5 with the Alameda County Office of Education, for no more than $1,277,826.55.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Pays up to $75,846.87 for 2022-23 student accident insurance through broker Myers-Stevens & Toohey
enrichment.summary: The board, as policyholder, approves the premium payment for blanket student accident insurance for fiscal year 2022-2023. The coverage applies to all enrolled students for injuries at school, during school-sponsored activities and while traveling to and from school. The payment goes to the insurance broker and may not exceed $75,846.87.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Blanket Student Accident Insurance - Premium Payment - Fiscal Year 2022-2023 - Risk Management Department

enrichment.headline: Pays up to $54,001.48 for 2022-23 catastrophic accident insurance for students and volunteers
enrichment.summary: The board approves paying for catastrophic accident insurance for students and volunteers for the 2022-2023 school year. One coverage class is for interscholastic athletics and one is for other school activities. The payment goes to the insurance broker and may not exceed $54,001.48.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Catastrophic Accident Insurance for Students and Volunteers – Premium Payment - Fiscal Year 2021-2022 - Risk Management Department

enrichment.headline: Hires School Facility Consultants up to $190,000 to pursue state and federal facilities funding
enrichment.summary: School Facility Consultants of Sacramento would help the district pursue state and federal funds for its building program, work on funding applications, and update eligibility for modernization and new construction. The cost is up to $190,000. Work runs July 1, 2022 to June 30, 2023.
